pages.text: The exact carriers are Orb, Arrow, Beam, Slash, Nova, Vortex, Trap, Chain, Rain, Dash, and Barrier. Orb is a straight projectile; Arrow is a fast low-gravity projectile; Beam is an instant ray; Slash is a close arc; Nova is self-centered area damage.

Vortex is a persistent pulling zone; Trap places a mine; Chain jumps through groups; Rain applies sustained area pressure; Dash combines movement with trail damage; Barrier is defensive.$(br2)Base cooldowns in listed order are 30, 15, 25, 20, 40, 45, 30, 35, 50, 25, and 60 ticks. Loaded server data can override carrier statistics.

$(bold)Workflow$(): use Beam or Arrow for precise targets, Slash or Nova when surrounded, Vortex/Trap/Rain to control an area, Dash to reposition, and Barrier for defense.$(br2)$(bold)Warning:$() Carrier tier is validated on Save. A visible choice does not bypass realm gating.
